$comment: Per-sheet fixes for the sprite cutter (D8). Format: scripts/sprite-packs/lib/overrides.ts. Cut indices are 0-based (the report's #n is index n-1).

common/props.note: pink glow around the campfire, torch, brazier and lantern; purple ash edge on the burnt-out campfire

mountain-and-cliffs/large.note: rope bridge drawn upright; the catalog sizes it 2 x 1

cave/props.note: spider web strands; purple fringe on the glowing mushroom cluster

cave/large.note: giant spider web strands; pink edges on the chasm crack and collapsed tunnel

dungeon/props.note: pink glow around the candle cluster

dungeon/large.note: pink at the foot of the stair down; candle glow on the altar

crypt-and-graveyard/props.note: pink glow around the lantern on a post; spiderweb strands

crypt-and-graveyard/large.note: pink edge on the catacomb niche wall

temple/props.note: pink glow around the candle flame

swamp/large.note: broken boardwalk drawn upright; the catalog sizes it 2 x 1

snow-and-tundra/props.note: pink snow edges on the animal tracks and the campfire in snow

snow-and-tundra/large.note: the first generation drew a second igloo as cut #10; it becomes igloo variant 2
pink edges on the snow-covered tent and the ice cave mouth

desert/large.note: pink edge around the giant skeleton ribs

town-street-and-market/large-2.note: chicken coop run netting drawn rose-pink (magenta mixed into the fill); the areas cover the run, not the hut

sewers/large.note: stone bridge over the channel drawn upright; the catalog sizes it 2 x 1

mushroom-cavern/props.note: purple rim on the glowing blue mushroom; pink glow around the drow lantern (not the purple mushroom, which is purple)

volcanic/props.note: pink smoke on the steam vent and smoking crater; purple soot on the scorched bones; magenta specks in the ember pile

volcanic/large.note: pink smoke on the fire geyser; pink edge on the lava bridge
